title: Recommendations to Friends and Family
summary: This topic centers on whether owners would recommend the car to friends or family, alongside unrelated mentions of affordability or other people asking about the car.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe actively recommending the car to friends and family because it is enjoyable, stylish, and stable to drive.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe steering friends and family toward another vehicle because of issues the owner experienced.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention friends, family, affordability, or outside interest without a clear evaluative stance on the car overall.

limitations: Many examples are incidental mentions of friends, family, or affordability rather than clear recommendation intent.
The cluster mixes recommendation behavior with unrelated social-interest and affordability comments, so the topic is only loosely coherent.
Several undetermined fragments are too brief or context-dependent to infer a definite sentiment.
